## What's free

With request-based billing, per billing account and month: 2M requests, 180,000 vCPU-seconds and 360,000 GB-seconds; scales to zero between requests

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://cloud.google.com/run/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

It scales to zero, so it can't keep a Cloudflare Tunnel open, and Cloudflare's free plan can't rewrite the Host header a run.app URL needs (Origin Rules do that on Enterprise only). A domain on Cloudflare needs a Worker in front of it (100,000 requests a day free) or a Cloud Run domain mapping. Public images come straight from Artifact Registry, Docker Hub or GHCR; private GHCR images through an Artifact Registry remote repository (0.5 GB of storage free). Needs a billing account, like the gcp stack.

## Plan

- `stack/`: a root module whose `platforms` output follows the [platform contract](../../docs/architecture.md#platform-contract), so [`hybrid/`](../../hybrid/) picks it up
- `freelunch deploy`: one service per app through the provider's API, from the app's Compose file (see [Northflank](../northflank/) for the pattern)
